acceptance_criteria.criterion: The script is standalone — does not require or depend on the framework bootstrap.
Running the script with no existing config files prompts for all settings with sensible defaults from the `.dist.php` templates.
Running the script with existing config files reads their current values and presents them as defaults; pressing Enter preserves the existing value.
The database connection test attempts a PDO connection to the specified host/port/user/password (without selecting a database); on failure, re-prompts for DB settings.
`generateDbConfig()` writes `test-db-config.php` with all constant values correctly replaced in the template.
`generateUiConfig()` writes `test-ui-config.php` with all constant values correctly replaced in the template.
`TESTSUITE_DB_PORT` correctly handles both integer values (e.g., `3307`) and `null` (empty/null input).
`TESTS_SESSION_TYPE` is always set to `'NoAuth'` without prompting the user.
The CAS config file (`test-cas-config.php`) is not generated or modified.
When `pcntl` is available, SIGINT during a password prompt restores terminal echo before exiting.
The script can be invoked directly via `php tools/setup-local.php` without errors.
